system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, this is Liam Khan. I have an upcoming flight from Houston (IAH) to Seattle (SEA) on May 23. I’d like to push that flight back by one day, so I’d be flying on May 24 instead. Also, I want to upgrade to business class for all passengers on that flight. Can you help me with that?

Thanks — I can help with that. I just need a couple things before I look up your booking:

1) Please provide your user id.  
2) Please provide the reservation id for the IAH→SEA booking (if you don’t have it, tell me and I’ll locate it for you).

To confirm your request: you want to move the flight from May 23 → May 24 and upgrade all passengers on that reservation to business class. A few important notes before I proceed:
- I’ll first retrieve the reservation to confirm cabin, fare rules, and whether the ticket is eligible for changes (basic economy cannot be modified; I must verify this).  
- If any segment has already been flown, I cannot make changes and will need to transfer you.  
- Changing flights may change the price. If there is a price difference, you must provide a single payment method (a credit card or a gift card) that already exists in your profile for payment/refund.  
- Travel insurance cannot be added after the initial booking.

Once you provide your user id and reservation id (or ask me to locate it), I will fetch the reservation and then list the exact change details and any price difference. I will only proceed with the modification after you explicitly confirm (reply “yes”) to the detailed action summary.
Sure, my user id is liam_khan_2521. I don’t have the reservation id handy—could you please locate it for me?
